svg.text: Secrets at service start: how the VM reads the vault without holding a key

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Segoe UI Web', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The service proves who it is to IMDS, receives a short-lived token, and reads only the secrets its role allows; nothing lands on disk, in the image or in source control.

svg.text: The vault answers only on a private IP inside snet-pe, resolved through the linked private DNS zone. A stolen token used from anywhere

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Segoe UI Web', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: outside the spoke is refused before RBAC is even consulted, and the outside-in test in SOP-AZ-105 proves that refusal every run.

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Segoe UI Web', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Controls supported: IA-5 (no stored secrets), SC-12 and SC-28 (keys and encryption), AU-2 (vault AuditEvent). Token lifetime and tmpfs path are the template defaults.

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Segoe UI Web', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Generalised design: no client names, tenant IDs, addresses or data. Icons are simplified originals, not Microsoft artwork.

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Segoe UI Web', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
